member.summary: Reads the next UTF-8 byte from standard input.
member.returns: A value from 0 through 255, or -1 at end of input.
member.exception: The input stream reports an error.
member.remarks: This hosted-only operation can allocate when it reports an error.

member.summary: Reads one UTF-8 line from standard input.
member.returns: An owned string without the line terminator, or null when end of input occurs before any bytes are read.
member.exception: Input fails, contains invalid UTF-8, or exceeds the maximum managed-string length.
member.remarks: The method flushes standard output before reading and can allocate.

member.summary: Specifies how a hosted file is opened or created.
Opens an existing file without truncating it.
Creates a file or truncates an existing file.
Creates a file or opens it for writes at the end.
Specifies the permitted operations on a hosted file.
Permits reads.
Permits writes.
Permits reads and writes.
Represents one owned hosted file resource.
member.remarks: The handle is move-only. Reserve lexical cleanup with .

member.summary: Represents a catchable hosted console or file error.
Creates an I/O exception without a host error code.
Creates an I/O exception with a host error code.
Gets the platform-dependent host error code, or zero when none was supplied.
Provides synchronous hosted binary-file operations.
member.remarks: These APIs are unavailable for ESP-IDF. Concurrent access to one handle requires external synchronization.

member.summary: Opens, creates, or appends to a hosted file.
member.param: A non-null UTF-8 path without an embedded NUL byte.
member.exception: The path, mode/access combination, conversion, allocation, or native open operation fails.
member.remarks: Use in a defer statement to consume the owned result.

member.summary: Reads bytes from a hosted file.
member.returns: The number of bytes copied. Zero for a nonempty buffer indicates end of file.
member.exception: The handle is not readable or the native read fails.

member.summary: Writes an entire byte buffer to a hosted file.
member.exception: The handle is not writable or a complete native write cannot be performed.

member.summary: Writes a managed string's exact UTF-8 bytes without a line terminator.
member.param: The non-null managed string to write.
member.exception: The handle is not writable or a complete native write cannot be performed.

member.summary: Flushes, closes, and consumes an owned hosted file handle.
member.exception: The native close reports an error. The handle is consumed even when this exception is thrown.
